issues.issue: Is the claimant excluded from refugee protection under Article 1(f) for committing serious non-political crimes before admission?
issues.applicant_position: Claimant alleges well-founded fear of persecution and explains circumstances of crimes and sentence served.
issues.respondent_position: Minister alleges claimant should be excluded for serious non-political crimes committed outside country of refuge before admission.
issues.result_text: Claimant excluded under Article 1(f)(b) for serious non-political crimes; serving sentence does not remove exclusion.
